title: Skin binding
summary: Binding the mesh to the skeleton: select the model then the armature, Ctrl+P > With Automatic Weights (the weights are computed from the bones). In pose mode the body now bends with the bones: an arm raised and bent, a knee lifted, the head tilted.
expected_result: The mannequin posed by its rig: one arm up and bent, one knee lifted, head tilted; the limbs bend smoothly.

steps.note: select the model, then the armature, Ctrl+P > With Automatic Weights
pose mode: the model moves with the rig -- an arm up
